name: Classification Consumer
summary: Consumes governed classification outcomes derived from scored evidence, compatibility checks, and policy thresholds.
description: Uses classification.outcome-resolve to convert scored evidence, candidate status, and compatibility facts into one governed outcome state. Needs deterministic provisional, surprising, unknown, or rejected outcomes without coupling the capability to any domain-specific source or workflow.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes a per-item governed outcome decision from scored evidence, rather than evaluating whether a classifier candidate can pass a release gate.
Needs one governed outcome for a scored item and candidate pair, rather than grouping embeddings into curated clusters.
